
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

ffr <- read_excel("DFF.xls", col_names = FALSE)
disct <- read_excel("DPCREDIT.xls", col_names = FALSE)
ioer <- read_excel("IOER.xls", col_names = FALSE)
iorb <- read_excel("IORB.xls", col_names = FALSE)
repo <- read_excel("RRPONTSYAWARD.xls", col_names = FALSE)

# Function to truncate dataframes and rename columns
truncate_and_format_data <- function(df, name) {
  
  # Identify the row where the first column has 'observation_date'
  start_row <- which(df[[1]] == "observation_date")
  
  if (length(start_row) > 0) {
    df <- df[(start_row + 1):nrow(df), ]
  }
  
  # Rename columns and convert date
  if (ncol(df) >= 2) {
    colnames(df) <- c("date", name)
    df$date <- as.Date(as.numeric(df$date), origin = "1899-12-30")
  }
  return(df)
}

# Apply the truncation and formatting function
ffr <- truncate_and_format_data(ffr, "ffr")
disct <- truncate_and_format_data(disct, "disct")
ioer <- truncate_and_format_data(ioer, "x")
iorb <- truncate_and_format_data(iorb, "x")
repo <- truncate_and_format_data(repo, "repo")

# Merge interest rates on reserves
iorb = rbind(ioer, iorb)
colnames(iorb) = c("date", "iorb")

# Combine three interest rates
joined_data <- iorb %>%
  left_join(disct, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(ffr, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(repo, by = "date")

joined_data = joined_data %>%
  mutate(
    iorb = as.double(iorb),
    disct = as.double(disct),
    ffr = as.double(ffr),
    repo = as.double(repo)
  )


write.csv(joined_data, file = "Zheng_Zhengtai_exercise3.csv", row.names = F)
```
